scope: Warm density-prefix opacity extension and575–800K integrated-envelope comparisons. No completed stellar continuation or source-physics accuracy claim.

native.scope: Native density-coordinate opacity interpolation at every cell midpoint and six H compositions. Positive finite means and central-difference derivatives. Physical errors require source and envelope checks.

reproduction.scope: Re-export all old and new source columns with the public generator, preserving explicit density prefixes. Numerical comparison, not a byte-identity requirement.

envelope.scope: Integrated 20-step-per-lnP envelope. Gas opacity in 16–30 kK is scaled from0.001to1000, with smooth shoulders12–16and30–36kK; conduction unchanged. Sensitivity is not an opacity accuracy claim.

SCVH_outside.reason: outside native SCVH density range at a bracketing temperature

assumptions: Same gas absorption and neutral-scattering approximation; no pressure-ionization correction is inferred from the comparison.
Conduction retains the fully ionized source; independent SCVH supports that ionization regime in the admitted new warm envelope states.
The opacity sensitivity is a practical structural check, not a measured uncertainty bound.
The independent575K atmosphere sources are local research inputs and are not included in this gas table.
